contract_gaps.observation: No exact provider-neutral input interface is defined for lexical, semantic, citation, or relation retrieval backends.
No canonical raw RetrievalCandidate artifact defines identity, rank, score, source locator, provenance, backend receipt, or integrity fields.
The contract does not map each lane to QueryPlan forward, reverse, null, boundary, method, temporal, or novelty query families.
Relation direction has no closed vocabulary, edge orientation, inverse predicate, reverse-query, or expected-result semantics.
Ranking normalization, cutoff timing, pre/post-deduplication order, duplicate identity, and deterministic tie-break rules are absent.
The exact integrity binding among QueryPlan, corpus snapshot, index version, backend response, candidate set, and SearchLaneReceipt is undefined.
Unavailable, partial, malformed, stale, or policy-denied backend responses have no authoritative fallback and terminal-state semantics.
The exit criterion 'vector-only retrieval avoided' has no executable minimum-channel, fusion, contribution, or provenance rule.
retrieval_benchmark has no authoritative corpus, queries, relevance labels, metrics, tolerances, or PASS thresholds.
relation_direction_test has no fixture, direction vocabulary, or exact expected answers.
O02 ownership does not say whether lane adapters return raw candidates, normalized candidates, or complete SearchLaneReceipt artifacts; workflow outputs are generic ResultEnvelope artifacts.
The resolving attempt lacks exact test, fixture, benchmark-corpus, and evidence write scopes outside the current implementation-only path.
